# Jeremy Rigney

> Dr. Jeremy Rigney is a Senior Data Scientist at Optum in Dublin, Ireland, working on agentic AI in regulated healthcare. He has a PhD in astrophysics from Queen's University Belfast.

## Career

- Senior Data Scientist, Optum (2026 to present): designs and builds agentic AI systems for a regulated healthcare setting, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) data contracts, grounding model outputs in trusted data, and evaluation and testing of LLMs and agents. Details of internal projects are confidential.
- Data Scientist, LexisNexis Risk Solutions (2025 to 2026): vehicle risk models and analytics.
- PhD, observational astrophysics, Queen's University Belfast (2020 to 2024): observing the Sun and other stars with some of the world's most advanced telescopes, and analysing terabytes of telescope data.
- BSc (Hons) Physics with Astronomy and Space Science, University College Dublin (2016 to 2020).

## Science communication

Jeremy Rigney is an award-winning science communicator, with over 60 talks, tours and conference presentations in six countries. Awards:
- IOP Rosse Medal
- Peter Curran Award
- Institute of Physics Three-Minute Wonder UK & Ireland Audience Award
